column4: Repair HH applications parser/selector drift so mesh-job-reply enumerates application rows; use live Note 3 credential recovery path as bounded fixture, add a regression for zero-row selector drift, and verify the scheduled reflex routes a durable owner task without mutating reply or calendar state.

Resolve the parked autostash blocking autoland on phaedra: inspect both stale stashes, preserve unrelated work, and produce a durable disposition plus verification that mesh-land --autoland can detect and route the refusal without silently replaying or dropping user work.

Resolve the ideas-queue handoff capacity incident: assign or charter an exact queue-tend owner, close/retire or safely widen the 27 aged in-flight items, and add a regression/reflex check proving the [ ] floor cannot hide aged [~] work.

Repair mesh-health-warning-task cursor/idempotency: a fresh health warning currently retries mesh-task create and fails because its deterministic health-warning chain already exists in BLOCKED state, leaving the reflex nonzero and the signal unrouted; add a regression for existing blocked chains, atomically advance only after recognized durable disposition, and verify the live cron path.
